items.title: AHA26: Semaglutide’s real-world CV benefits highlight importance of persistence
items.summary: Real-world semaglutide CV outcomes mirror clinical trials, with greater treatment persistence linked to better outcomes.

items.title: BIO Europe: Financing, AI and geopolitics shape biotech discourse
items.summary: Speakers at BIO-Europe 2026 noted that European biotechs must be agile and adaptable in times of geopolitical and financial upheaval.

items.title: FDA puts commissioner’s priority voucher framework on ice

items.title: Neurosterix pockets $105m to advance neuropsychiatry pipeline
items.summary: Neurosterix hopes that NTX-253 may compete with BMS’s Cobenfy as the schizophrenia field explores mechanisms past dopamine modulation.

items.title: BMS sets unified research and development structure for 2027
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) is set to merge its separate research and development (R&D) departments into a single entity, effective from 1 January 2027.
